rows.text:
# Internal Resistance

The unfamiliar weight of the feline body settles around you—four legs instead of two, a tail swishing behind you, whiskers twitching at every sensation. Your consciousness struggles within this alien frame, instinct pulling one way while your will fights for control.

*This isn't right. This body isn't mine.*

You push back against the feline urges rising up through your new nerves, asserting yourself despite the overwhelming strangeness of your current form. The effort burns through your resolve like exertion through muscles.

Your willpower—trained and tested in your original form—clashes with the innate reasoning of this feline mind. The battle rages internally, a silent war between who you were and what you've become.

And then... a shift. Your conscious control asserts itself just enough to carve out a small space of mastery within this borrowed body. The feline instincts don't vanish—they're still there, lurking beneath the surface—but they've loosened their grip just slightly.

Your resolve wavers from the exertion, but you've won this small victory. You've proven that even in this form, your will can still assert dominance.

For now.
